Suboxone Maintenance
Suboxone is prescribed to me for opiate addiction (heroin). I take 32 mg sublingual daily, in the form of 8 mg tabs.
Honestly there is no buzz.  It does kill withdrawals and cravings for other opiates however.  Suboxone should not be mixed with any other drugs, especially benzodiazapenes, barbituates, alcohol, and other opiates.  I am currently coming off the suboxone over a 14 day period and the withdrawals are bad, but not as bad as other opiates.

Personally I would take a nice blast of Ms. H over bup any day of the week.  I miss heroin alot. Anywho good for medical reasons, not good for recreation.
